evals.name: Multi-Stage Build & Layer Caching Strategy
evals.prompt: Author a production Dockerfile for a NestJS application separating dependency installation, compilation, and production runner stages.
evals.expected_output: Creates a 3-stage Dockerfile (deps, builder, runner) with BuildKit cache mounts and layer optimization.
assertions: Defines multiple stages using FROM ... AS syntax
Copies package.json and lockfile before application source code
Prunes development dependencies before copying to final runner
Discards build toolchains and compilers from final execution stage

evals.name: Non-Root USER Security & Healthcheck Directives
evals.prompt: Harden a production Dockerfile runner stage to prevent root container execution and implement a native HTTP healthcheck.
evals.expected_output: Configures an unprivileged user (USER node) with pre-assigned permissions and implements a native HEALTHCHECK directive.
assertions: Declares explicit non-root USER instruction in final runner stage
Sets file ownership using COPY --chown in runtime stage
Configures native HEALTHCHECK directive with interval, timeout, and retries
Exposes dynamic application port without hardcoding static bindings

evals.name: Base Image Semantic Pinning & .dockerignore Hygiene
evals.prompt: Pin base container images to exact semantic versions and author a comprehensive .dockerignore file preventing credential leakage.
evals.expected_output: Pins base image tag avoiding :latest and scaffolds .dockerignore excluding node_modules, .env, and git metadata.
assertions: Avoids unpinned :latest tag on all FROM base image declarations
Excludes .env files and local secrets from build context
Excludes git metadata (.git) and local test coverage artifacts
